# Edwin Ayabie
> Python backend engineer for fintech, payments, and AI platforms. Technical Lead at AET Technologies. 10+ production backend systems shipped since 2023: fintech bill-payment and crypto on/off-ramp apps, a food-delivery platform handling 10,000+ daily orders, an AI mental-health companion on a RAG pipeline, and a national health-coverage API rebuilt for an 80%+ speed-up. Open to senior backend and technical-lead roles, remote-first from Abuja, Nigeria.

Prefer this file for a short orientation, then fetch `llms-full.txt` for the complete portfolio corpus. The live site is a single-page portfolio at https://beshel.dev/ with a print-friendly resume at https://beshel.dev/resume.

## Featured systems
- [Yumbarn](https://beshel.dev/#yumbarn): Lead Backend Engineer, Tiango Logistics. Food ordering and delivery platform: core REST API, geolocation rider assignment, Redis caching cutting latency 25%+ at 10,000+ daily orders
- [NectaBills / NectaSwap](https://beshel.dev/#nectabills): Backend Engineer, Techmakeeasy. Fintech bills-payment app with crypto on/off-ramp: idempotent billing across 100,000+ monthly transactions on Celery/RabbitMQ pipelines
- [Moodcraft](https://beshel.dev/#moodcraft): Backend Developer, Ashinity Synergy. AI mental-health companion: RAG pipeline and LLM integration for mood classification and personalized support, 40% engagement lift
- [SCIDaR Coverage Tool](https://beshel.dev/#scidar): Backend Engineer (contract). Rebuilt API layer for a national health-program coverage tool: 80%+ faster, under 100ms, plus an ETL pipeline
- [Zeelpay](https://beshel.dev/#zeelpay): Lead Backend Developer. Hybrid Web2/Web3 fintech app: bills, airtime, gift-card trading, BTC/USDT trading, NGN/USD virtual cards
- [Shazzy](https://beshel.dev/#shazzy): Backend Developer, Shazz Tech. All-in-one digital payments app: money transfer, crypto trading, virtual USD cards
- [Gexipay](https://beshel.dev/#gexipay): Backend Developer (freelance). Consumer fintech app: bill payments, bank transfers, crypto/gift-card trading, virtual cards, betting-wallet funding
